title: Cannot filter logs by OrderId
summary: Passing an interpolated string to ILogger loses the structured properties. Switch to a message template and pass the values in order.

turns.user: trying to filter by OrderId in Seq and its not there. the number is right there in the message tho

assistant.body: TL;DR: the interpolated string is fully built before it ever reaches the logger. ILogger only gets finished text, so it has no idea which part was the OrderId. Best practice is a message template that keeps the placeholders, with the values passed as arguments after it. The name in {OrderId} becomes the property name. The CA2254 analyzer warns about exactly this.

turns.user: add the tracking number too. the one MarkShippedAsync returns

assistant.body: Sure. The tracking number goes in a third placeholder. Note: values are matched to the template by position, not by name, so {TrackingNumber} and its argument have to sit in the same place in each list.
